title: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 餐桌礼仪 (dining etiquette) 是中华传统文化的重要组成部分，蕴含着热情有礼的待客之道。为了招待客人，主人会根据客人的口味和喜好准备丰富精致的菜肴。就餐座位的安排非常讲究，主人坐在正对大门的位置，在主人身边就座的是最重要的客人。进餐时，主人会不时地为客人添酒加菜。这种独特的餐桌礼仪已延续了数千年，对促进和谐的人际交往起到了重要的作用。
reference: Dining etiquette is an important part of traditional Chinese culture, embodying the warm and courteous way of treating guests. To entertain guests, the host prepares rich and exquisite dishes according to their tastes and preferences. The seating arrangement is very particular: the host sits in the seat directly facing the gate, while the most important guest sits beside him. During the meal, he refills wine and adds more dishes for the guests from time to time. This unique dining etiquette has lasted for thousands of years and has played an important role in promoting harmonious interpersonal relationships.
